name: terminal-departures
vibe: An airport departures hall for films. A dark FIDS terminal — dim slate ground, a light sweep across the concourse, a soft vignette, a masthead and an analog clock whose second hand laps the whole film, a scrolling yellow ticker band. The SIGNATURE is the SPLIT-FLAP BOARD: every headline arrives by mechanically cycling characters in Solari-style flap cells with a scaleY 'clack' per swap. Around it: a live departures board, hanging gate signs that swing in on ceiling pivots, a baggage belt carrying labelled cases, a security beam that x-ray-pings each style tag it crosses, and a mounted gate MONITOR that shows a real product screenshot. Warm amber/ivory over near-black, IBM Plex Mono chrome under Space Grotesk display. Rendered as a native GSAP + SVG/CSS composition. Best for launches, waitlists, travel/logistics, and bold 'your idea departs today' hooks.
